# Yorkshire Green Heating Ltd

> Family-run, Gas Safe registered plumbing and heating company based in Doncaster, South Yorkshire. Boiler installation, boiler repair and servicing, central heating, bathrooms, mobility bathrooms, water softeners and emergency plumbing across Doncaster and the DN postcodes.

## Service area

Doncaster and the surrounding DN postcodes, including Balby, Bessacarr, Cantley, Armthorpe, Bentley, Mexborough, Conisbrough, Thorne, Tickhill, Rossington, Bawtry and Askern.

## Services

- New boiler installation (combi, system and regular boilers)
- Boiler repair and annual boiler servicing (£114 inc VAT)
- Central heating installation, radiators and powerflushing
- Bathroom and en-suite installation
- Mobility bathrooms and walk-in showers
- Water softener supply and installation
- Smart thermostat installation (Hive, Nest, tado)
- Emergency plumbing and heating call-outs
- New-build plumbing and facilities management

## Our boiler installation process

1. Free home survey — we inspect the existing system, measure heat-loss requirements, and discuss budget and preferences.
2. Written quote — a clear, itemised quote covering boiler, materials, labour and extras. No obligation.
3. Installation day — Gas Safe engineers remove the old boiler and complete pipework, flue routing and electrical connections. Most straightforward swaps finish in a single day.
4. Testing and commissioning — the system is pressure-tested, safety-checked and commissioned to the manufacturer's specification.
5. Paperwork and handover — Gas Safe installation certificate, manufacturer warranty documentation and a full explanation of the controls.
6. Aftercare — annual servicing to keep the warranty valid and the system efficient.

## Boiler brands we install

Baxi, Viessmann, Vaillant, Worcester Bosch, Glow-worm, Ideal and Potterton.
